title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.30.0 adds a CodeLens that runs Gradle tasks directly from build.gradle.kts declarations.

highlights.title: Gradle Task CodeLens
highlights.description: Adds a CodeLens above each task declaration in build.gradle.kts, so you can run a Gradle task straight from the editor instead of switching to the terminal or Gradle panel.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added a CodeLens above Gradle task declarations in build.gradle.kts files, letting you run a task with one click right where it's defined.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No other functional changes in this release.
